testdata/rept-exitm.asm:
    1                                           rept 3
    2                                             ld a, $i
    3                                             exitm if $i == $count - 1
    4                                             ld hl, $i
    5                                           endr
    5                                         + $COUNT = 3(0x3)
    5                                         + $I = 0(0x0)
    5  0000 3e 00                    [ 7]     +   ld a, $i
    5  0002 21 00 00                 [10]     +   ld hl, $i
    5                                         + $COUNT = 3(0x3)
    5                                         + $I = 1(0x1)
    5  0005 3e 01                    [ 7]     +   ld a, $i
    5  0007 21 01 00                 [10]     +   ld hl, $i
    5                                         + $COUNT = 3(0x3)
    5                                         + $I = 2(0x2)
    5  000a 3e 02                    [ 7]     +   ld a, $i
    6
